x: In a 10 miles road race which started and finished on the track, our team of Steve Charlton, Tom Carter, Dick Towndrow and Roy Minahan came second in the team race which was won by the local club.
On the same day at Chertsey, Charlie Smart won an open 5 miles road race and with Steve Charlton fifth and Roy Minahan eighth, we beat Reading A.C. in the team race and so won another trophy.

Stone the Surrey cross-country champion and our first man home was Roy Minahan in eighth place. With the individuals being deleted we managed to come out on top in the team race but only by the narrow margin of one point over Wadham Harriers, with Thames Valley third.
